name: 🚨 Create Issue in Uetlib Repository
description: All issues for this project should be created in the https://github.com/UbiqueInnovation/uetlib repository.
body:
- type: markdown
  attributes:
  value: |
  🚨 **This repository does not accept issues. Please create your issue in the [uetlib repository](https://github.com/UbiqueInnovation/uetlib).**

      Thank you for your understanding!
